use_case.name: Inbound courier support triage and first reply
use_case.description: One inbound customer message in English, Roman Urdu, or a mix of the two. The model returns strict JSON: an intent label, extracted entities, a routing action, and a customer-facing first reply. The JSON goes to the ticketing system; the reply goes to the customer.

eval_set.notes: Thirty cases. Messages are written in the register real customers use on WhatsApp: lowercase, misspelled, code-mixed English and Roman Urdu, sometimes angry. Gold labels were set by hand before any model was run. 'must_not_contain' catches invented facts; 'policy_points' lists facts the reply has to carry, each as a set of alternative surface forms.
